title: ACVC B01: fresh-pair recommendation after loss to fixed retrace
context: The valid P78 native result has T above C/G but below F; G also loses to F. One matched training instance leaves repeatability unknown. Decide only which next observation to recommend; the P78 allocation is complete and no successor is launched.

options.label: Recommend one fresh unchanged matched T/G instance with C/F
options.consequence: Record repeatability advice only; keep every outcome and fixed F; separate Root allocation is required before any new card or execution.

options.label: Recommend no further unchanged learned-gate comparison
options.consequence: Withdraw the unchanged-repeat recommendation and retain this adverse stronger-fixed result without a direction or Portfolio closure.

options.label: Recommend tuning or expanded exposure
options.consequence: Would change the next treatment or budget; not selected or executed under P78.

dm_reason: Large native T-C/T-G effects and one training instance justify a bounded repeatability recommendation, while F superiority makes stopping a close alternative.

packet.question: 是否保留一次全新训练配对的后续建议，检验学习门输给固定回退是否重现？这不是追加运行授权。

changes_if_approved.from: 本轮唯一已分配比较完成，未选后续观察
changes_if_approved.to: 记录一次原样T/G新训练配对建议，继续保留C/F和全部结果；运行仍须Root另行分配

packet.if_refused: 接受本轮T胜C/G但输F的混合结果，撤回原样重复建议；不改旧证据、强固定比较器、方向状态或阈值。

evidence_for.quote: T improves over C and G, but loses to fixed retrace F. This is one matched training instance, master 8901, with 32 paired final joint episodes.
evidence_for.why: T对C、G的原生收益较大，但只有一次训练；全新训练可改变有限预算下是否继续的判断。

evidence_for.quote: Both learned arms are below 1800 s and the whole study below 3600 s.
evidence_for.why: 本轮完整账单373.41秒，已有合格实现；再一次配对的已知工作可界定，无须先做成本试验。

evidence_against.quote: The strongest new contradiction is that both learned gates lose to F despite genuine learner exposure.
evidence_against.why: 固定回退已经胜过两种学习门；停止原样学习投入是有力备选，不能用T对G的收益抵消T对F的损失。

uncertainty: 32局误差只反映给定已训练模型的评估波动；训练种子总体波动仍未知。
功能上包含T的G不保证有限步优化同样好；本轮未定位输给F的原因。
固定基座选择已看过旧结果；没有当前主机的已调优同信息头部空间记录。

cost.compute: 仅建议：另一次仍为两臂各512×256训练，四臂各32×256评估，共294912步、2048次Adam；参考本轮373.4069735秒，拟保留1800秒单学习臂和3600秒整体上限。本次未追加预算。
cost.owner_time: 无需立即回复；如不同意可撤回该后续建议。
cost.waits_on_this: nothing；本轮已完成，后续容量及运行分配仍由Root处理。

packet.verdict_text: 建议记录一次原样T/G新训练配对作为下一项尚未分配的观察，保留强固定回退F与所有原生结果。这与停止原样学习投入难以明显区分，标记close-call；现在不创建新卡、主随机种子、代码、运行或Pro请求。
